title: Inferno
author: Dan Brown
summary: Robert Langdon wakes in a Florence hospital with a head wound and no memory of the last two days. He and a young doctor flee assassins and follow clues taken from Dante's Inferno.
readIf: you like Langdon's puzzle-chases and are happy to see Italian art, history and a doomsday plot mixed together.
skipIf: you are tired of twists that depend on being kept in the dark, or dislike stories about overpopulation fears.

pairings.reason: The original, in which the same hero follows art-history clues in Paris with a similar rhythm.
Another Langdon thriller set across Rome, with a ticking clock and a clever structure.
A more serious spy novel that also begins with a hero who cannot remember his past.
